assessment: No outstanding actionable static correctness, custody, control, API/schema or scope finding in the frozen v4 profiling harness.

review_basis.current_review: Read complete 290-line profile v3 and its supervisor/config deltas, then the entire frozen v3-to-v4 delta for both changed files. Independently verified all eight current module hashes.
review_basis.approved_amendment: The independently verified ordered-cell relabel benchmark amendment remains fixed; no additional performance or physics exception is introduced.

resolved_before_execution.finding: v3 separately re-read deck/request descriptor hashes and omitted their three defining native files from supervisor end fences.
resolved_before_execution.resolution: v4 hashes the exact deck/request buffers parsed or compared by the child. Metadata was already parsed and hashed from one captured buffer.

Required counts are supports1,bodies264,ports264,angles792,springs792; total and each supported ceiling are2113; binary is the literal installed default6c.

checked_current_contract: Exact original FCStd and raw/canonical restored-connectivity pins are retained. No historical files or model properties are rewritten or rebound.
Original coordinates and restored ordered connectivity are checked with short boolean failures. Mesh snapshots retain raw group IDs, names, types, membership and order before/after the public export.

Historical deck/request/PORT comparisons are explicitly diagnostic only; no old physical qualification is inherited. Strict future new-baseline/candidate deck-except-timestamp, request and native-ID parity remains required.
Exactly one public write is counted and profiled with wall/process CPU timing, explicit progress phases and nonadditive profile-overhead scope. No arbitrary timing SLA is introduced.
Actual written sidecar capacity is bound to captured deck/request hashes, exact complete declaration counts,2113 configured ceilings and default bundled native6c.

Supervisor requires exactly identity.json, export-profile.json, run.log, whole-public-write.prof, profile-cumulative.txt, native/Mesh.inp, native/Mesh.accounting and native/Mesh.accounting.json. Parsed receipt/log buffers are captured once, log is bound to run_bounded, native descriptors are bound to child buffers, and all eight hashes/sizes are end-fenced.

Literal app identity, source/runtime separation, isolated directories, null stdin, root-owned bounded cleanup, serial checks, source/manifest custody, protected app/user directories and16 dependency pins remain unchanged.
